content: To succeed in your mission, you must have single-minded devotion to your goal.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
explanation: Scattered energy yields mediocre outcomes. Remarkable breakthroughs demand uncompromising focus, emotional resonance, and consistent daily dedication to the core mission.
practicalInsight: Identify your single most vital mission for this week. Say 'no' to three minor, distracting requests to protect your primary focus.
reflectionPrompt: Where is my energy leaking into secondary trivialities?
